nodes.title: SG-4 Build the interface frame kit and design tokens
nodes.body:
Context: palette (src/lib/palette.ts, 48 colours), art pipeline (src/art/sources.ts, generateAssets, art:generate) and Tailwind exist, but the UI is unframed and only ui/cursor-hand.png exists. Desired behavior: tokens defined once and exposed as CSS vars and Tailwind theme values, fonts from @fontsource, generated nine-slice frames, components using them with a four-state button. Expected result: the game screen uses the kit. Why: shared look for every later component.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the palette, when tokens are built, then every colour token equals a PALETTE value and is exposed as a --sf-color-* CSS variable and a Tailwind theme colour
- Given art:generate, when it runs, then PNG frames for bar, panel, plaque, parchment card, slot and four button states exist with manifest entries
- Given a Button with each state, when rendered, then normal, hover, pressed and disabled classes are present
- Given the repo, when searched, then no panel-frame, sound or pointer SVG remains under game/public


## Scope
- In scope: tokens
- In scope: @fontsource fonts
- In scope: frame PNG sources
- In scope: frame CSS classes and components
- In scope: wiring into header, layout, story panel, suggest trigger
- Out of scope: new rooms
- Out of scope: story content
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Out of scope: audio
- Out of scope: deployment
- Out of scope: repository clean-up
- Out of scope: header/story panel rebuild
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: Go API contracts
- Preserve: existing hand cursor
- Preserve: existing tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
- All art is generated raster pixel art from palette grids; no downloads or CDN
- Palette at most 48 colours, defined once
- Fonts bundled via npm, not URLs
- Unit tests with all dependencies mocked


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green


## Non-functional requirements
- image-rendering: pixelated on all frames


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Import PALETTE_RAMPS from ./palette. Export COLOR_TOKENS as an object mapping ink, plum, moon, hoodie, wood, brass, parchment, lamp to PALETTE_RAMPS[ramp] arrays (no new hex literals). Export SPACING_TOKENS {1:'4px',2:'8px',3:'12px',4:'16px',6:'24px'}. Export TYPE_TOKENS {fontPixel:"'Press Start 2P', monospace", fontBody:"'VT323', monospace", sizeSm:'12px', sizeMd:'16px', sizeLg:'24px'}. Export tokensToCssVars(): Record<string,string> emitting --sf-color-<ramp>-<1..6>, --sf-space-<n>, --sf-font-pixel, --sf-font-body, --sf-size-<sm|md|lg>.
steps.code: export function tokensToCssVars(): Record<string,string> { /* build from the three maps */ }

steps.action: Import plugin from 'tailwindcss/plugin' and tokensToCssVars, SPACING_TOKENS, TYPE_TOKENS. Add theme.extend.colors.sf as an object mapping each COLOR_TOKENS key and step to var(--sf-color-<ramp>-<n>), theme.extend.spacing entries sf-<n> -> var(--sf-space-<n>), fontFamily pixel/body -> var(--sf-font-pixel)/var(--sf-font-body), fontSize sf-sm/md/lg -> var(--sf-size-*). Append plugin(({addBase}) => addBase({':root': tokensToCssVars(), body:{fontFamily:'var(--sf-font-body)'}})) to plugins after animate. Keep colors.pal, background, primary untouched.
steps.expected: npm run typecheck passes and config still exposes colors.pal

steps.action: Using createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex from ./draw, export buildFrameGrid(spec:{w,h,slice,ramp,border,lightStep,darkStep}):Grid that fills the body with a shadeRect gradient, draws a 1px outlineRect in rampIndex('indigo',0), 1px highlight along top/left and shadow along bottom/right, and a brass 2px corner block of size slice. steps.code: export const UI_FRAME_SOURCES: ArtSource[] = FRAME_KIT.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, path: `ui/frames/${f.file}.png`, frames: [buildFrameGrid(f)] }));

steps.action: Import UI_FRAME_SOURCES from './uiFrames' and spread it into ART_SOURCES immediately after the ui/cursor-hand entry.

Test generated CSS objects and rendered classes with stores mocked as needed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Frame classes include borderImage and pixelated
- Button renders four states
- Header, layout, story panel carry frame classes


## Scope
- In scope: tests/frameKit.test.tsx
- Out of scope: product code
- Preserve: tests/ui.test.tsx


## Technical constraints
- Unit tests only; no browser


## Dependencies
- A4


## Definition of done
- frameKit.test.tsx passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
nodes.summary: Unit tests for frameKit, Frame, Button states and wiring
nodes.description: Test generated CSS objects and rendered classes with stores mocked as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Frame classes include borderImage and pixelated
Button renders four states
Header, layout, story panel carry frame classes

steps.symbol: it('frame classes use border-image and pixelated')
steps.action: Call frameComponentClasses(); for each of bar, panel, plaque, parchment, slot assert key '.sf-frame-<name>' has imageRendering 'pixelated' and borderImage containing the FRAME_KIT file name and its slice. Assert keys '.sf-btn', '.sf-btn:disabled', ".sf-btn[data-state='hover']" and ".sf-btn[data-state='pressed']" exist with different borderImage values.

Render <Button variant='frame' state=S> for S in normal, hover, pressed, disabled with testing-library; assert each has class 'sf-btn' and data-state S, and the disabled one has the disabled attribute. Render <Frame kind='panel'> and assert class sf-frame-panel.

steps.symbol: it('game screen components apply the kit')
steps.action: Render GameLayout with header, scene, story nodes; assert aside has class sf-frame-panel. Render HeaderOverlay with worldTitle 'W' and no round after resetting useUiStore via setState; assert the header has sf-frame-bar and the Settings button has sf-btn. Render StoryPanel with an inventory of one item and assert the item li has sf-frame-slot and the Dialogue region has sf-frame-parchment (use props shape from src/components/StoryPanel.tsx).
